PHASE.NAME: RTK Parity Inventory Gate
PHASE.GOAL: Add a machine-checkable RTK parity inventory that compares Synapse capabilities against rtk-develop domains before deeper adapter work.

STEPS.step-1: Expose a compact parity report for RTK filters, proxy shortcuts, router families, local adapters, hooks, discovery, and analytics.
STEPS.step-2: Validate filter parity from source-derived inventory instead of manual counting.
STEPS.step-3: Validate routed command-family parity against the planned adapter catalogue.
